title.en: ChatGPT announces a limited Wallet rollout for dot purchases
title.zhHans: ChatGPT 宣布有限推出用于 dot 购物的 Wallet

searchSummary.en: ChatGPT announced Wallet for dot-assisted purchases, requiring user approval and a security check for each purchase.
searchSummary.zhHans: ChatGPT 宣布用于 dot 辅助购物的 Wallet，每笔购买均需用户批准和安全验证。

summary.en: On November 13, ChatGPT publicly announced Wallet for purchases carried out by its dot agent. The public post says agents cannot access actual card details and each purchase requires a security check. The post is truncated after stating rollout to Pro subscribers; separate reporting says access initially covers adult U.S. Pro users.
summary.zhHans: 11 月 13 日，ChatGPT 公开宣布让 dot 代理使用 Wallet 完成购物。公开帖子称代理不能读取真实卡资料，每笔购买都需安全验证；该帖子在提及面向 Pro 用户推出后即被截断。另据媒体报道，初期准入限定为美国成年 Pro 用户。

narrative.en: This is a limited rollout of an agent-assisted payment feature, not evidence of universal merchant compatibility or risk-free autonomous checkout. Payments Dive reports a separately attributed Amex spokesperson confirmation of its first agentic-commerce integration, while eligibility details in the truncated primary post require attribution to 9to5Mac. Neither source establishes the scale of active usage or an independently reproduced transaction test.
narrative.zhHans: 这是智能体辅助支付功能的有限推出，不证明所有商户兼容或代理结账没有风险。Payments Dive 引述美国运通发言人确认其首次智能体商务集成；被截断的官方帖子未载明全部准入条件，因此美国及年龄限制须归因于 9to5Mac。现有材料不证明实际活跃使用规模，也不是独立复现的交易测试。

text.en: On November 13, ChatGPT announced a limited Wallet rollout for dot-assisted purchases; its post says agents do not receive actual card details and each purchase requires a security check.
text.zhHans: 11 月 13 日，ChatGPT 宣布有限推出供 dot 辅助购物使用的 Wallet；其公开帖子称代理不接触真实卡资料，每笔购买都须安全验证。

claims.notes: The official public post directly supports only announcement, limited Pro rollout, card-data boundary and security-check requirements. Payments Dive reports separately on card-network participation; it is not an independent validation of all security guarantees.

text.en: According to 9to5Mac, initial access is limited to U.S. ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18 or older.
text.zhHans: 据 9to5Mac 报道，初期准入仅面向年满 18 岁的美国 ChatGPT Pro 用户。

claims.notes: Not present in the truncated official oEmbed text; source-attributed secondary detail, not a core B-grade fact.

text.en: According to 9to5Mac, Wallet will not work with sites that block agent access; broad compatibility, active use and security outcomes have not been independently audited.
text.zhHans: 据 9to5Mac 报道，Wallet 不适用于拦截代理访问的网站；广泛兼容性、实际活跃使用及安全效果尚未经独立审计。

claims.notes: Limits are based on reporting and absence of independently observed broad compatibility; not a claim that specific transactions failed.
